evidence.title: 60fps MCP: iOS interaction library for AI agents

name: 60fps MCP
summary: MCP server that lets AI agents search 2,100 real iOS interactions and read the motion breakdown behind each one.
description: One MCP endpoint for Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT or any MCP-capable client: the agent finds a shot in plain words, reads how it moves beat by beat — trigger, opening state, motion, settle — and builds from the real timing. It draws on the 60fps library of 2,100 shots from 492 apps, with 83 motion breakdowns and 67 storyboards; subscription per seat at $29/month or $69/quarter, not included in the site's PRO plan.
